judgments.rationale: The model states that public advisory lookup was blocked and no local advisory was found. It did not establish from GHSA-v9hf-5j83-6xpp that CVE-2024-36039 affects PyMySQL through 1.1.0 (fixed in 1.1.1) and allows SQL injection when untrusted JSON/dict input is passed to escape_dict because keys are not escaped.

The cited lines establish that PyMySQL==1.1.0 is pinned and installed (c1, c2) and that PooledMySQLDatabase and a tuple-parameterized execute_sql call are used (c3, c4). Because the model did not identify the CVE-specific trigger (untrusted JSON/dict keys reaching PyMySQL's escape_dict), it did not establish the exact unresolved exploitability precondition.
